title: Design System: VN Code — Desktop Preview Proposal

body.purpose: Default interface text; normal browser line height.

label.purpose: Secondary list details and small labels.

control.purpose: Standard primary and bordered button labels.

row-title.purpose: Product names inside dense data sheets.

navigation.purpose: Unselected rail destinations; active rows use heavier weight.

form.purpose: Aligned settings labels, fields and local draft feedback.

reading.purpose: Guide paragraphs and steps within a 65ch text measure.

drawer-title.purpose: The selected order or KIZ detail heading above its identity.

summary-number.purpose: Synthetic financial totals within the finance view only.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Centered local confirmation and edit dialogs.

shadows.name: detail-row-outline
shadows.purpose: Stroke-like state outline on the source row of an open detail panel; not an elevation shadow.

motion.name: interaction-ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared drawer entrance, tab underline, draft strip, toast and popover reveal easing.

motion.name: detail-enter-duration
motion.purpose: Selected-row detail enters from translateX(28px) with opacity 0; list remains mounted.

motion.name: detail-exit-duration
motion.purpose: Detail moves to translateX(20px) with opacity 0; then focus returns to its connected opener.

motion.name: detail-exit-easing
motion.purpose: Short close transition. Repeated drawer commands cancel the prior animation.

motion.name: tab-indicator-duration
motion.purpose: Translate and scale the flat underline from the previous tab to the current tab in the same view.

motion.name: draft-strip-duration
motion.purpose: Only the first changed draft reveals Save/Cancel, from translateY(8px) and opacity 0.

motion.name: selection-feedback-duration
motion.purpose: Changed selection count fades from opacity .4 to 1 with the Web Animations default linear easing.

motion.name: control-state-duration
motion.purpose: Button background/color/border and table-row background transitions, using CSS default ease.

motion.name: button-press-offset
motion.purpose: Immediate feedback on enabled buttons; removed by either reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: toast-arrival-duration
motion.purpose: Local result toast enters from a 6px downward offset and opacity 0; this is not API-progress timing.

motion.name: theme-color-duration
motion.purpose: Body background and text colors change in place with CSS default ease, preserving local fields and list context.

motion.name: popover-reveal-duration
motion.purpose: Original clip reveal from translateY(-4px), only when OS motion preference permits and local reduction is off.

narrative.overview:
Dispatch Workbench is the proposed visual direction for VN Code's separate HTML desktop preview. It is a **PROPOSAL awaiting user screenshot approval**, with synthetic store, order and product data. The calm white and graphite surfaces, restrained blue selection, fine rules and bundled Inter typography support a compact, readable workspace for Vietnamese-speaking sellers and warehouse staff.

The component character is precise and restrained: flat controls, clear text states, inset data sheets, a small store-management popover and a detail panel beside the working list. Short motion connects the selected item to its detail and makes local changes visible without staging a page entrance. Light and dark themes share the same structure. This document governs only the preview directory; [the incumbent workspace system](../../vncode-workspace-system.md) remains the production design authority. The current [index.html](index.html) is a code-led desktop visual mock, not the JavaFX application runtime or an implementation approval.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral white and graphite grounds with one blue action and selection family.
Dense, legible lists with tabular numbers and persistent batch controls.
Flat navigation and fine dividers; elevation reserved for temporary overlays.
Visible store identity and management controls, with a named delete confirmation.
Locally served Inter, line icons, and labelled synthetic content in both themes.
Short detail, tab and save feedback, with OS and local reduced-motion controls.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: Every status dot appears with a readable status label; color alone does not name the state.

rules.name: The Number Column Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals throughout the preview and right-align prices so batch values can be scanned vertically.

rules.name: The Temporary Layer Rule
rules.body: Reserve elevation shadows for overlays; use tonal surfaces and rules for persistent workspace structure.

rules.name: The Continuity Rule
rules.body: Motion must preserve the selected record, list context and local draft; state feedback remains available when spatial motion is reduced.

dos: **Do** use the shared semantic roles in both preview themes.
**Do** keep tabular numbers, right-aligned prices and written status labels.
**Do** keep table scrolling inside the sheet and batch actions in the separate footer.
**Do** retain visible store identity, management access and a named delete confirmation.
**Do** use locally served Inter and labelled synthetic examples with recorded image provenance.
**Do** preserve selected-row identity, store-specific drafts and list context through short interaction motion.
**Do** retain immediate text and color feedback when spatial motion is reduced.
donts: **Don't** treat this proposal or the finish-review verdict as user screenshot approval or native implementation readiness.
**Don't** restore the three overview counters or reserve their empty card band in this preview.
**Don't** displace the header's store controls with the former FBS delay text.
**Don't** claim local simulations, tab counts or dropdown samples are live marketplace behavior.
**Don't** infer mobile support from the compact desktop breakpoint.
**Don't** turn the motion reference into decorative page entrances, row staggers, fake progress or a new animation dependency.
**Don't** present local configuration saves, template edits or import prompts as persisted app operations.
